Joining as an Inventor in Toyota Woven City
Hitachi Construction Machinery has joined as an Inventor in Toyota Woven City, a test course for mobility developed by Toyota Motor Corporation and Woven by Toyota, Inc.
We will utilize Woven City as a living laboratory to help shape the future of construction sites, and apply the insights gained through our testing in the development of future products, services, and solutions.
Our proof-of-concept trial will combine construction machinery and digital technologies to optimize construction operations and enhance remote support using sensing technologies, topographical information, and machine operational data. Leveraging the data utilization expertise cultivated through our ConSite service solution, we aim to improve safety and productivity at construction sites while also reducing environmental impact.

Had an insightful and rewarding week participating in the Google Cloud Customer Advisory Board (gCAB) in Mountain View.

Looking forward to continuing our partnership and turning these strategic insights into impact!

What does it take to build an ever-better car for customers in the software-defined age?
A connected, collaborative approach to software development. 🤝
The new RAV4 and Lexus ES show what this can look like. When software is part of the vehicle development process from the start, teams can ideate, build and test faster, while continuing to create better experiences for drivers and passengers long after the vehicle is delivered.
The Arene platform helps connect this work globally, bringing teams across architecture, software development, testing and simulation onto a shared foundation.

Woven by Toyotaのアクセシビリティオフィスチームでは障害のある方を対象とした、6ヶ月間のキャリア・リスキリングプログラムを開始します。
(English follows Japanese)
このプログラムではIT・ビジネススキルを身につけながら、自身の強みや可能性を発見し、次のキャリアへ踏み出すための6ヶ月のトレーニングを提供します。
こんな方におすすめです:
・実務経験が少なく、これから仕事の経験を積みたい方
・Google WorkspaceやSlack、生成AIなどのデジタルツールを学びたい方
・キャリアチェンジや自分の強みや得意分野を見つけたい方
・グローバルな環境や英語に触れることに興味がある方 (プログラム参加時の英語力は不問)
誰もが自分らしく働き、一人ひとりがさまざまなキャリアや将来の可能性に挑戦できる機会を広げることを目指しています。
応募条件・詳細はこちら:
https://lnkd.in/gW2Mh5R9

・Are looking for your first job experience

We want to create more opportunities for everyone to work in a way that’s true to who they are, and to explore the many different career paths open to them.

October 8
A year of real-world testing at Woven City is already feeding back into the technology.
About 160 residents across roughly 80 households are now taking part in proof-of-concept trials, and seven new Inventors bring the community to 31. Their feedback is shaping products like our Integrated ANZEN System, which is soon set to expand beyond the city.
On the AI front, Woven City AI Vision Engine 2.0, an update due by the end of 2026, adds the ability to reason about why events occur and has recorded world-leading scores on more than 10 benchmarks.
Each trial and update informs the next, with more on the way.
See the full details behind year one at Woven City: https://lnkd.in/eCWygWw4

Woven by Toyota
October 7
📸 Our Vision AI team brought a week of research and collaboration to the recently held #ECCV 2026 in Malmö!
The team presented two papers exploring how AI can better understand what it sees, and co-organized two tracks at the 10th AI City Challenge focused on transportation safety understanding and generative traffic video forecasting.
The challenge drew 325 team registrations from 26 countries and regions, and we were thrilled to see one of the track’s winning work featured in ECCV Daily by Computer Vision News!
Thank you to our collaborators, participating teams and to everyone who joined the conversations. We are all excited to keep building on this research with the community in the months ahead!
Dive into the full papers below 👇
☑️ Where to Look Matters: Learning Influential Views for VLM-based 3D Visual Grounding: https://lnkd.in/eW7tCmRk
☑️ Synthetic Visual Genome 2: Extracting Large-scale Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs from Videos: https://lnkd.in/e2xufxGp

It was an honor to welcome Yumi Otsuka, Woven by Toyota’s Corporate Adviser and Senior General Manager for Sustainability Management at Toyota Motor Corporation, to our Palo Alto office!

What does it take to turn cutting-edge AI research into technology that works in the real world?
That was the question at the heart of AI DEV Day, hosted by our AI teams for engineers across Toyota group companies.
The event brought together:
🎤 Keynotes on the latest research and its path to practical applications
🧪 Hands-on demos of technologies in development
💬 Open discussion on how these technologies can make an impact
At Woven by Toyota, our AI teams are applying advanced AI to real-world challenges to help create healthier, more connected communities. From research to development, and from development to real-world impact, we're building technologies for well-being.
